description:
In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...! 

 *“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”* 

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

**Fifth Short Story The First Night After Divorce:** Once a rising star, actress Oh So-Ra dreamed of a glamorous comeback to the entertainment world through her divorce ceremony! But days later, contrary to expectations, she faced a barrage of public criticism. Fleeing reporters, she sought a secluded place and headed to the Mansion Youngchunhwa. But what do you know? There she runs into her recently divorced ex-husband, Jung Hyun! The shock is short-lived. On their first night at the mansion, Jung Hyun's aggressive advances(?) lead to a fiery night together. The next morning, however, only So-Ra remembers the night. Still bewildered, before she could find answers, "Ru-Ri and “Tae-Oh” arrive at the Youngchunhwa Mansion one after another, sparking a subtle tension between the four.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
